page.overview:
Who is Loneliness Fiend?

The の|Kodoku no Majin}} was a Devil that embodies the concept of loneliness. He is the main antagonist of the third chapter of Chainsaw Man: Buddy Stories.

The Loneliness Fiend appears to take the form of an average man with numerous fangs.

Not much is know about the Loneliness Fiend's personality, other than the fact that his main goal doesn't seem to be to kill and eat humans, but to make humans feel the same loneliness as its deceased host.

At some point before Aki Hayakawa became a devil hunter, the Loneliness Devil possessed the corpse of a man who died alone in an apartment complex.
